title: Fantasy Football Last Place Garden Flag - Funny Loser Punishment
description:
Quick listing notes: This product listing and the layout were assisted by AI. Flags are produced on demand by our production partner Printful.

Product overview
- 12 x 18 inches garden flag printed in a bold green scoreboard treatment. Design intent: a direct, in-your-face last-place label for fantasy football leagues — humorous, competitive, and good-natured.
- Same design is printed on both sides (double-sided print).
- Weather-resistant polyester fabric.
- Top pole sleeve for standard garden-flag poles.
- Printed to order.
- Garden-flag stand is not included.

Exact printed text on the flag (do not edit):
Eyebrow: SEASON RESULTS
Printed phrase lines: "LAST PLACE IN" "FANTASY FOOTBALL"
Footer: WORST TEAM IN THE LEAGUE

Use occasions
- Draft day, draft party, end-of-season event, toilet-bowl punishment, league watch party, office or home display. Designed to make the league loser wear/display their defeat with bold, funny humiliation.

Care & display
- Made for outdoor use but avoid prolonged exposure to extreme weather to extend life. Spot wash or gentle hand wash and air dry.

Notes
- Garden-flag stand/pole not included. Flag comes with top sleeve to slide onto a standard garden pole.
- Printed to order by our production partner Printful. Listing and layout assisted by AI.
rationale: Scoreboard style + green palette match the requested 'green scoreboard treatment' and read clearly at a distance. The title and tags focus on high-value search terms like fantasy football, last place, loser punishment, and gag gift. Description lists all verified product facts, includes the exact printed phrase lines unedited, and discloses AI assistance and the production partner for transparency
